detail.longDescription: The :xubuntu: @ xubuntu team launched a brand-new wiki this week, replacing our old DokuWiki instance with a Git-backed, Hugo-powered static site hosted on GitHub Pages. It's now easier than ever to contribute to our community wiki. I've shared a technical look at how we got here on my blog: https:// seand.xyz/blog/2026/11/26/rebu ilding-the-xubuntu-wiki-preserving-20-years-of-history/ Many thanks to the folks who gave feedback and to the @ ubuntu team for switching the DNS in record time. # Xubuntu # Wiki # DokuWiki # Hugo # GitHub
